notablePrerequisites: Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Midnight Guard using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Midnight Guard token enters the battlefield, each other Midnight Guard you cotnrol triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.
